ctx.x: I knew Mr. Classy. I knew him personally. I remember what he looked like. But, well, music, of course, in those days. Honey, you didn't have a television. You didn't have a radio. You didn't have music under your nose all the time. You know what I mean? Yeah. The only time you heard any music was when you went to a show or down to the store and asked somebody to play some pieces for you. And then you, what did I start to say about the dances? You know, I played for dances at first. Just in somebody's residence.…
Oh, yeah. Do you remember a song plug I thought of? Dave Frank. He used to run the music department at Whirlines in late years.
I knew him. I don't remember that I knew him as a song plugger.
